extracted.name: Salsa verde (green sauce)
extracted.description: Try our delicious salsa verde recipe with tarragon, parsley, capers and wild garlic. This herby green sauce is perfect with traditional roast chicken and fish.
ingredient_lines: 40g small capers drained, rinsed and roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Chop the herbs and garlic, mixing with 1 tsp sea salt, until very fine.
Add the mustard and capers, and combine. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the olive oil.
Add the vinegar, little by little, stirring and tasting as you go – trust your palate!
